name: Quebec rent-fixing rules (TAL) — 2026 base percentage
description: Quebec has no fixed cap: a tenant may refuse a proposed increase and the Tribunal administratif du logement (TAL) then fixes the rent using its regulation. Under the new regulation in force 1 January 2026, the base percentage is 3.1% (plus building-specific adjustments).

attributes.regulation: Regulation respecting the criteria for the fixing of rent (Gazette officielle no. 51, 17 December 2025)
attributes.binding: Reference used by the TAL when it fixes rent; not an automatic cap

sources.title: Applicable percentages to the criteria for the fixing of rent

limitations: Rules for newly built dwellings and building-specific adjustments were not researched in Phase 1; use the TAL calculation tool.
